analysis: Both units are base-side text of docs/provider/cli-reference.md (a documentation-only file, status modified). No patch hunks or head-side text were supplied, so I could not identify which lines changed. This is a coverage limit, not evidence that the change is safe. I read the base text against the TB-009 and TB-011 definitions and the canonical header notes. The doc describes the macOS <27 upgrade notice, which is informational and performs no network, config or profile operations. It says enroll on macOS 27+ returns App Attest guidance and is never a serving grant. It says enroll on older macOS requires a linked provider token and a fresh SE-key proof at POST /v1/enroll, and that new identities require qualified App Attest. This matches the TB-009 and TB-011 policy and the frozen legacy MDM cohort description. The doc also says unenroll --keep-serving requires fresh coordinator App Attest removal readiness (consistent with TB-011), that restart can confirm self_route authorization without claiming public eligibility, and that Autopilot consent does not grant authorization. Nothing in the visible base text contradicts the threat model. If the head diff changes statements about MDM removal, App Attest readiness or the owner self_route wording, the next pass should check them against TB-011, T-052, T-057 and T-058. Source code behavior in provider-swift (Enrollment.swift, ProviderOnboardingPolicy.swift, UnenrollCommand.swift) was not supplied and is unverified.
